user.title: Connect to akenza
user.description: Create an API key in akenza (Organization settings → API keys) with read access to workspaces, assets, device types and device data, then paste it here.

import_mode.title: Data points
import_mode.description: Import all data points of the selected devices (recommended – you can restrict them later in the options), or restrict data points per device type now.

data_point_keys.description: Deselect the data points you do not want in Home Assistant ({count} known). Entities of deselected data points are removed; new data points that appear later stay enabled. Deselecting a `topic · *` entry drops the whole topic.

data_points_next.title: Data points

send_downlink.name: Send downlink
send_downlink.description: Queue a downlink for an akenza device. Either a JSON payload (encoded by the device type's downlink script) or a raw hex payload.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Home Assistant device(s) managed by the akenza integration.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: JSON object passed to the device type's downlink encoder.

device_not_found.message: The selected device is not an akenza device.

payload_required.message: Provide either a payload or a raw hex payload.

topic_required.message: MQTT devices need a downlink topic.

downlink_unsupported.message: Downlinks are not supported for {connectivity} devices.

downlink_forbidden.message: The API key is not allowed to send downlinks.

missing_permissions.title: akenza API key of {organization} lacks permissions
missing_permissions.description: The API key cannot call: {endpoints}. Devices are still imported, but manufacturer/model, product images or data-point schemas may be missing and devices without a device type get no entities until they send data. Create a key with read access to organization, workspaces, assets, device types and device data, then use *Reconfigure* on the integration.

workspace_unavailable.title: Selected akenza workspace(s) unavailable for {organization}
workspace_unavailable.description: The workspace(s) {workspaces} were selected for import but no longer exist or the API key has lost access to them. Their devices were removed from Home Assistant. Open the integration options and adjust the workspace selection to clear this issue.

stream_disconnected.title: akenza live stream for {organization} disconnected
stream_disconnected.description: The WebSocket live stream has been disconnected for more than 10 minutes; measurements are not updated live. Home Assistant keeps reconnecting automatically. Check the internet connection and https://status.akenza.io. This issue disappears once the stream is back.
